title: AI-Centered Universities and AX Graduate Schools
summary: MSIT talent programme that funds universities to rebuild their teaching around AI. The 2026 call opened on 19 January 2026. On 29 September 2026 MSIT launched 18 AI-centered universities (3 new and 15 converted from the earlier software-centered university programme) and 15 AX graduate schools at a ceremony at Yonsei University. AI-centered universities receive about KRW 3 billion a year for up to eight years to strengthen AI majors, require basic AI courses for all students and create AI-convergence courses; AX graduate schools receive KRW 3 billion a year for up to six years to train master's and doctoral AI-convergence talent.
beneficiaries: Universities and their students; 11 of 18 AI-centered universities are outside the Seoul metropolitan area
